Test that when no match, returns 0 and writes nothing.

Test that when multiple matches overlapping, longest selected.

Test that constructor with null lookup results in shortest = Integer.MAX_VALUE? Actually if lookup null, loop not executed, shortest remains Integer.MAX_VALUE, longest 0; translate will set max = longest =0, then for loop from max down to shortest? Test that constructor with empty lookup array leads same.

Edge case: duplicate keys? Last one overrides.

Potential exception: Writer throws IOException may propagate; we can create a Writer that throws.
